visibleEvidence: The Front peaks are 3,4,1 and the Left peaks are 2,4,3. At the seven occupied Top cells, the height rows 211 / 141 / 300 attain 13. At least 13 are needed since the last row is a single height-three column, the middle peak of four has to be in row two and row one must reach two. Filling every allowed position to its cap gives 16; 12, 17 and 18 fail.
presentation: The Front, Top and Left panels have legible headings, consistent upright grids and complete external boundaries. The accompanying stem specifies the projection alignment; its A–D labels and values are legible.
method: Independent reading of this final PNG and its full displayed stem preceded program comparison. Exact SHA-256 matches of both files preserve the same blind decision in this build.
